anomalies.details: Moved from sitemap.xml/plugins-engineering-it/ to sitemap.xml/plugins-productivity/ between the 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25 snapshots (lastmod also bumped as part of the same-day plugin-directory template refresh).

21 of the 23 plugin pages removed today were first_seen exactly 6 days ago in the 2026-09-19T09-15Z run and are now gone (HTTP 404 confirmed on 3 spot-checked URLs: floot, make, whisper-transcribe-ai). One removed plugin (alpaca) had been listed since 2026-07-10. This reads as a short-lived batch of third-party plugin listings that was approved on 2026-09-19 and pulled six days later, coincident with a same-day template overhaul of the surviving ~140 plugin pages.
